scope: Non-scoring boundary diagnostic on the same frozen training sample. Standalone complete aliases only; no command-followed prefix is compared to whole-file activity end.
activity_rule: Existing frozen10ms RMS rule: peak*.01 with floor1; cap activity endpoint to original source length.
limits: RMS activity is not phonetic ground truth. File-end labels versus source activity can explain apparent premature crossings without proving missing/early keyword recognition or causation of false wakes. No audio or metadata was changed.
